en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
At that time the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group of six monks were teaching the Dhamma to one wearing sandals...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I will not teach the Dhamma to one who is not ill while wearing sandals.
One should not teach the Dhamma to one who is not ill while wearing sandals.

Whoever, out of disrespect, teaches the Dhamma to one who has stepped on [a seat], or put on [shoes], or taken off [shoes], when not ill, commits an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*). There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
The first training rule is concluded.
